betaData.title: How Commuter Rail data is collected
betaData.collection: TransitMatters collects this data using the <v3Api>MBTA's V3 API</v3Api>. It isn't cleaned or filtered before display, so we may occasionally miss trips or stops. Confirm anything you see here against official MBTA sources when possible. See our <github>GitHub repository</github> for technical details.
betaData.benchmarks: Benchmarks start on October 4, 2026, when we began comparing each train to its own schedule. Before then they were often another train's, so we don't show them.

betaRum.text: This is our internal beta. It collects extra usage and performance data with Datadog to help us find bugs. The public dashboard doesn’t.

notices.busData: Bus data isn't guaranteed to be complete for any stop or date, which may affect headway figures in particular.
notices.crBetaAccuracy: Commuter Rail data is in beta — headways and travel times may be incomplete or inaccurate.
notices.sameDay: Data from today may be incomplete — it arrives with a delay of up to two hours.
notices.terminus: Data collection at terminus stations can be incomplete, which may affect travel time and dwell figures in particular.
notices.gobbleData: For these recent dates, data is collected via the <v3Api>MBTA's V3 API</v3Api> and isn't cleaned or filtered — expect reduced accuracy. Official MBTA data is shown once available.

greenLineSlowZones.title: Green Line slow zones are less precise
greenLineSlowZones.body: Green Line service is more variable than on the heavy rail lines, and much of it runs on the street rather than on a <gradeSeparated>grade-separated</gradeSeparated> right-of-way. Slow zone detection here is more prone to error than on other lines.

bnrd.default: This route was upgraded as part of Better Bus Network (Bus Network Redesign).
bnrd.route40_50: The combined Route 40/50 that runs on weekday evenings, Saturday evenings, and Sunday will be discontinued.
bnrd.route85: The CT2 and 85 will combine to be the new Route 85, with new service extending to Assembly.
bnrd.route86: This route was shortened to run between Reservoir and Harvard Square, with improved midday, evening, and weekend service.
bnrd.route87: All Route 87 trips will travel between Lechmere and Arlington Center. The route pattern that ends at Clarendon Hill will be discontinued.
bnrd.route104: This route now offers new crosstown service between Malden Center and Logan Airport, with buses every 15 minutes or better.
bnrd.route109: This route now extends to Harvard Square and runs more frequently, with service every 15 minutes or better.
bnrd.route110: This route now offers improved frequency between Wellington and Wonderland, with service every 15 minutes.
bnrd.route116: This route now combines former Routes 116/117 with improved frequency, running every 15 minutes or better.
bnrd.route350: All Route 350 trips will now serve Burlington Mall Rd.
bnrd.route65: Route 65 was restructured to run between Brighton Center and Ruggles via the Longwood Medical Area, replacing its former Kenmore terminus, with improved frequency and span of service.
bnrd.route60_65Legacy: Routes 60 and 65 were previously combined for display here. Route 65 was restructured to run between Brighton Center and Ruggles via the Longwood Medical Area; Route 60 is now shown separately.
bnrd.route220: Route 220 now serves only Hingham Depot (the Hingham Center pattern was discontinued) and Route 222 now serves only Lovell Corners (the East Weymouth pattern was discontinued), both with improved frequency.
bnrd.route220Legacy: This reflects the combined Route 220/221/222 pattern before Sept. 6, 2026. Route 220 dropped its Hingham Center pattern and Route 222 dropped its East Weymouth pattern; see the current Route 220/221/222 for the present-day pattern.
bnrd.route434: Outbound Route 435 trips now end at Liberty Tree Mall instead of continuing to Salem Depot.
bnrd.route434Legacy: This reflects the combined Route 434/435/436 pattern before Sept. 6, 2026, when Route 435 still continued past Liberty Tree Mall to Salem Depot; see the current Route 434/435/436 for the present-day pattern.
bnrd.route465: Route 465 was restored as a pilot route between Salem Depot and Danvers Square via Liberty Tree Mall.
